d:
Nabalig se dushkarm ke mamle men kangres vidhayak bhushan bara par ranchi ke dhurva thana men kand darj hone ke bad siyasat shuru ho gaee hai. pradesh bhajpa ne kangres vidhayak bhushan bara ki sadasyata samapt karne ki mang karte hue jamkar nishana sadha.
